# Data Integrity Checklist: SPEC-013A Run-State Persistence Spine

**Purpose**: Validate data-integrity requirements for additive persistence, attempt identity, lifecycle history, projection consistency, optional run linkage, archive behavior, and SPEC-013B boundary protection.
**Created**: 2026-05-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Additive Migration And Rollback Integrity

- [x] CHK001 Are additive migration requirements defined for the exact attempt and lifecycle tables without destructive changes to existing runtime or task data? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Migration Plan]
- [x] CHK002 Are migration rerun/idempotency requirements explicitly paired with live schema evidence expectations, including table shape, index shape, uniqueness, and foreign-key health? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024, Spec §SC-010, Plan §Migration Plan]
- [x] CHK003 Are rollback requirements clear about child-first removal, SPEC-013A migration-marker cleanup, foreign-key checks, and operator backup/data-loss warnings? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Spec §SC-007, Plan §Migration Plan]

## Attempt Identity And Lifecycle History

- [x] CHK004 Are attempt identity requirements complete enough to distinguish workspace, task, stage, attempt number, status, timestamps, archive state, workflow-template context, and optional run linkage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §Task-Stage Attempt]
- [x] CHK005 Are lifecycle-history requirements explicit that event rows are append-only observed facts and projection changes do not imply claim ownership or state-machine authority? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §Lifecycle Rules]
- [x] CHK006 Are lifecycle vocabulary requirements bounded to exactly the SPEC-013A states and clear that unknown or future states fail closed for writes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases]

## Projection And Query Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Are current-state projection requirements consistent with lifecycle history requirements, including archive projection, `updated_at`, and lifecycle snippet ordering? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §Read Model]
- [x] CHK008 Are ordering and bounded-read requirements specified for attempts and lifecycle snippets so task-detail inspection stays deterministic and reviewable? [Measurability, Data Model §Ordering, Contract §Attempt Ordering]
- [x] CHK009 Are workspace-scope masking requirements defined for attempt reads without leaking nonexistent versus out-of-scope task identity? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Auth]

## Runtime Run Link Integrity

- [x] CHK010 Are optional `run_id` requirements clear that the link is nullable, soft, app-resolved, and never a database foreign key to runtime runs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Research §Optional Runtime Run Link]
- [x] CHK011 Are requirements explicit that attempt rows do not duplicate authoritative runtime-run execution fields such as steps, cost, eval, provenance, tags, or full metadata? [Completeness, Data Model §Runtime Run Summary, Contract §Security And Safety Requirements]
- [x] CHK012 Are missing or unavailable runtime-run link states specified so attempts remain inspectable when a linked run cannot be resolved? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Run Link States]

## Archive And SPEC-013B Boundary

- [x] CHK013 Are archive requirements non-destructive across current projection, timestamp evidence, lifecycle event evidence, and default query visibility? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-003, Data Model §Lifecycle Rules]
- [x] CHK014 Are uniqueness and index requirements limited to attempt-number identity and inspection, with no one-active-attempt, claim token, owner, lease, lock, or duplicate-launch authority? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-023, Data Model §Constraints And Indexes]
- [x] CHK015 Are read API and UI requirements free of claim, retry, release, cancel, launch, scheduler, GitHub, sandbox, harness, or auto-merge controls? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-021, Spec §SC-008]

## Notes

- Focus areas selected: additive/idempotent schema changes, append-only lifecycle integrity, projection consistency, optional runtime-run linkage, non-destructive archive behavior, and strict no-claim boundary.
- Depth level: formal review gate.
- Actor/timing: peer reviewer during SpecKit checklist phase before task generation.

## Re-run Validation

- [x] CHK016 Are the newly added migration evidence requirements traceable from functional requirements through success criteria and implementation verification? [Traceability, Spec §FR-024, Spec §SC-010, Plan §Verification Plan]
- [x] CHK017 Are live schema evidence requirements specific about SQLite table, index, migration-marker, and foreign-key health inspection without prescribing claim-authority behavior? [Clarity, Plan §Migration Plan, Quickstart §Migration Schema Evidence]
- [x] CHK018 Are idempotent rerun requirements measurable as a second migration application with no duplicate tables, indexes, lifecycle rows, or migration markers? [Measurability, Spec §FR-024, Plan §Migration Plan]
- [x] CHK019 Are schema evidence expectations consistent with the no-SPEC-013B boundary by limiting uniqueness to attempt-number identity and inspection indexes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Spec §SC-010, Data Model §Constraints And Indexes]
- [x] CHK020 Are rollback and forward-migration health checks aligned around foreign-key verification without adding an automated rollback runner? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Plan §Migration Plan, Quickstart §Rollback Check]
